headline: Late Wire Finds Row, Mercy Active, Expanse Quiet
war_summary: Since the 18:10 edition the wires show the pace easing in the west while two southern sectors carry the late exchange. The Weathered Expanse records no seizures in the last two hours, last noted at 18:37 about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch with 22 in the day, and now stands five Warden to four Colonial with no unheld ground, correcting the earlier split. Fisherman's Row counts three seizures in two hours to 19:55 about Black Well, Dankana Post and others with 16 in the day and stands nine Colonial. Linn Mercy adds three in two hours to 19:41 about Lathair and Rotdust with 11 in the day and stands eleven Colonial. The Gutter and Farranac Coast are quiet since 17:42 and 15:58 about The Parras and Transient Valley, standing seven Warden and eleven Colonial. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf remain without a seizure in six hours despite day losses exceeding 11,000 and 3,400 Colonial, while Nevish Line, Mooring County and Dead Lands report heavy casualties with no late flips.
